board/runtime/board_business.py.change: Only add wrapper import and replace injectable default worker_factory; exact other AST preserved

behavior.timer: process-local monotonic RAM; no schema or DB schedule
behavior.success: Clear retry streak and pending cooldown
behavior.idle_no_work_cancelled_stale_commit_cloc: Do not add failure or extend cooldown
behavior.exception_classification: InterruptedError or original cancellation predicate true becomes cancelled; TimeoutError becomes deadline_exceeded. No exception message parsing.

covers: Exact capped schedule and cooldown without model calls
Original bodies retained through repeated failures
Success resets and empty work does not count failure
Invalidated source plus socket failure treated as cancellation
Pre-lease database busy preserves original exception

limitations: A new worker process starts without the previous RAM cooldown
Cooldown is worker-wide and can postpone unrelated idle summaries up to 60 seconds
No malformed summary is adopted and no source body is removed by retry scheduling
No actual model or production acceptance claimed
